progress.command:
git "commit" "-m" "feat: add a thinking_level input (default: pi's medium)

pi-action never set a thinking level, so pi-durable used "off" for every
run, also for models with reasoning. thinking_level (off, minimal, low,
medium, high, xhigh, max) is set on the agent at the start of every run,
so a continuing thread switches to it. pi-action caps it with pi-ai's
clampThinkingLevel, as pi does: off for a model without reasoning, with a
log line. The setup line shows the level. An invalid value fails the run.

Refs #66"
